reutilities.configuration.title: §6§l[Reutilities]§r Options
reutilities.configuration.rendering.tool: Options related to rendering of Reutilities' features.
reutilities.configuration.item.tooltip: Options related to items (or its tooltips) added or changed by Reutilities.
reutilities.configuration.compat.tooltip: Compatibility options for other mods, added by Reutilities.
config.reutilities.render_outfits.toolti:
Whether to render outfits on your player model and first-person hand.
Disabling this makes the rendering fall back to vanilla.
config.reutilities.render_outfit_on_hand: Whether to render outfits in the "chest" slot in your first-person hand.
Whether to render chestplates in your first-person hand.
config.reutilities.color_emissive_outfit: Whether emissive parts of outfits should be colored.
config.reutilities.light_emitting_emissi: Whether light-emitting blocks should be emissive based on their light level.
config.reutilities.show_components_with_: Whether to display an item's data components when holding Alt.
config.reutilities.line_breaks_on_compon: Whether component display on tooltips should have line breaks.
config.reutilities.panoramic_screenshots:
Whether panoramic screenshots can be taken using Ctrl + [Screenshot Key].
§eIf Iris Shaders is loaded, panoramas will not be taken correctly.
config.reutilities.panoramic_screenshot_:
How big the each screenshot should be. Defaults to 1024px.

Increasing the resolution will lead to images with better quality, but at the cost of performance and storage space.
Which folder panoramic screenshots should be saved to. Defaults to "panorama".
config.reutilities.maximum_bust_size.too:
How big the breasts added by Female Gender Mod can be. Defaults to 0.8.
§eValues above 1 cause the rendering to increasingly fail.

item_behavior.behaviorapi.add_experience: Gives the player a set amount of experience levels or points depending on its NBT.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.apply_mob_effe: Applies effects from its 'effects' tag. Effects are applied separately from this behavior.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.clear_mob_effe: Clears any effects the entity may have.
Damages the entity eating with a specified damage source and amount.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.eat_item.desc: Eats an item from the behavior's NBT.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.explode.desc: Creates an explosion on the entity eating. It has a configurable radius, set fire and damage source.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.ignite.desc: Ignites the entity eating on fire for a specified amount of ticks.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.play_sound.des: Plays any sound in the game. Has a configurable volume, pitch, sound category and even if it comes from the player.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.remove_effects: Remove specific effects from the entity if they have it.
item_behavior.behaviorapi.teleport_entit: Teleports an entity either randomly or to a specific position.
